rationale: Spec alignment — concern. Exact approved historical-path-design-review-r2 (8 members) and historical-path-delivery-review (plan) match. Most implementation follows the narrowed all-family contract, but historical-reference-suffix-routing violates VAL-SR-27/30 and TG-PATHS by accepting unsupported namespaces solely through a reference basename. This requires implementation correction, not a new policy decision.

Test coverage — concern. Reviewed reductions by responsibility: archive/old examples, obsolete tool/fixture/lifecycle routes, absent model substitutions and Release replay tests were intentionally retired; current canonical owner sets replace circular old/new equivalence. Portable/current symlink, tracking, marker/privacy, record safety and catalog detail remain. The 202 to 186 method change is not adequacy proof. New generic unknown and no-launch cases miss misleading known-resource suffixes; require a compact ownership-boundary regression and retained current projection positives, not a retired-name ledger.

Edge cases — concern. Reviewer directly ran six native selector methods: canonical_tools_select_independent_owner_checks, model_selection_keeps_unsupported_exact_input, model_selection_rejects_current_portable_symlink, git_discovery_includes_deleted_and_both_renamed_paths, current_model_executes_through_trusted_ci_command_boundary and mixed_unknown_input_stops_real_ci_before_execution (each under ValidationSelectionTests). All six passed. They prove exact flat rejection, current symlink rejection, current unstaged/staged/committed deletion/rename and real trusted-model execution/missing-index failure, but the separately reproduced reference-suffix bypass shows additional outcome-changing classification composition remains unprotected.

Error handling — concern. Ordinary unknown inputs block with no public-wrapper check launch and exact unsupported flat subjects reach admission. In contrast, an absent docs/examples/references/boundary-first-method-v1.md input returns selector ok with only boundary_first.reference_regression; actual public CI runs reference regressions and reports Selected CI checks passed. Mixed with scripts/validate-release.py also selects successfully. Thus surviving suffix classification can invent successful validation for unsupported input.

Architecture boundaries — pass apart from the finding. Canonical current tool/test/resource classification replaces predecessor maps in main routing and related boundary helpers; trusted executor caller drops discovered_paths with command builder, retaining exact command comparison. Current model declarations and portable same-name paths remain distinct from catalog packages. Catalog/selector/executor architecture and record/release owners remain unchanged.

Compatibility — concern limited to the finding. All six intended families are removed from explicit maps/categories, generic flat acceptance is withdrawn and historical source-to-receiver substitution removed. Current System root, portable same-name models, current release wrappers/module, ordinary plans/proposals and current-record archival exclusion retain ownership. The remaining global suffix accepts obsolete or unknown namespaces despite that withdrawal. Old-looking inputs under legitimate current schema/template/package owners remain allowed by their existing contracts; this is different from a suffix granting ownership anywhere.

Security/privacy — pass for retained inspected surfaces, with integrity impact of the finding retained. Public model checks preserve lexical subjects, path containment, diagnostic redaction and no-write behavior. No source conversion, record-identity rewriting, permission expansion, external operation or publication added. The suffix defect is a validation-integrity failure; no unauthorized write was observed.

Derived artifact currency — pass within local scope. Reviewer independently built clean adapter archives using build_adapter_archives(v0.3.6,tempdir), then ran validate_clean_install_smoke(v0.3.6,tempdir,skill_names=(design,)) against the real locally packed CLI for both supported targets: errors empty. Current model-authoring resource SHA256 f2eb9c36b036165461b0c9fbd64c08eba5cf4b5d4bbdc3038fccdf6f9934bbe5. This proves actual clean generated/installed Design resources; version is a private fixture label, not release selection. Existing selected archive tests also independently compare complete canonical resource sets.

Unrelated changes — pass. Scope remains compatibility-only; merged three-model catalogs/test rules and feature-format withdrawal are retained. No physical fixture files deleted in this diff, broader catalog rollout, record version migration or stash restoration. Parent reported 127 current script/test paths with baseline/current status and check-ID parity; independently named current-owner tests corroborate meaningful cases without using that parity as the sole oracle.

Validation evidence — concern in adequacy, not result attribution. All 17 implementation evidence subjects and exact upstream approval members match. Inspected final local log reports 1001 passed rows/Selected CI checks passed; author records boundary29, all-model checks and19skills and openly discloses intentional red/development failures/interrupted earlier run. Direct reviewer six-method run and clean Design install passed. The positive broad run does not detect the reproduced false-success path, so clean milestone handoff is not justified. Required committed PR-range CI is still explicitly downstream and not claimed.

Published guidance semantic assessment — pass. Exact changed opening plus complete method context distinguish explicit project-selected layout from portable docs/design/M/M.md; generic flat validation is unsupported while existing source authority/bytes/review identities remain unchanged. A proposed decision to create a supported same-name target under authoring authority is consistent; automatically relocating an existing flat source or retargeting its old review is not. No repository-specific alias registry, automatic adoption or mandatory historical dependency introduced. Source reading and stage-owned Design/Delivery handoffs remain coherent. Assessment is instruction meaning plus installed-resource availability, not target-agent behavioral execution.
